name: worktrees
description: Gives every agent that can edit a git worktree of its own, runs a project's setup script with its own port range, stops only the processes that setup script recorded, removes an agent's worktree and branch once the session merges it, and tidies other merged branches on demand with /tidy

noIsolateAgents.title: Agent types without a worktree
noIsolateAgents.description: Comma-separated agent types that never get a worktree, on top of Explore, Plan, claude-code-guide, statusline-setup, scout and reviewer.

readOnlyAgents.title: More read-only agent types (deprecated)
readOnlyAgents.description: Old name for noIsolateAgents, still read. The types listed in either one run without a worktree.

isolateNestedRepos.title: Isolate agents in a repo with nested repos
isolateNestedRepos.description: Give agents worktrees even when the repo's ignored directories hold their own git repos and the repo has no .claude/worktree-setup script. Off by default: such agents run in the main checkout.

portBase.title: Port base
portBase.description: Worktree slot N owns ports portBase + N*10 through portBase + N*10 + 9. Slots start at 1, so portBase..portBase+9 stay free for the main checkout.

tidySuperseded.title: Tidy superseded agent branches
tidySuperseded.description: Let /tidy delete an unmerged agent branch that is an old version of files the default branch has since rewritten, after keeping its tip at refs/archive/tidy/<date>/<branch>.

tidySupersededDays.title: Days before a branch can be superseded
tidySupersededDays.description: How many days since its last commit before /tidy may call an agent branch superseded.

tidyArchiveRefs.title: Archive ref namespaces
tidyArchiveRefs.description: Comma-separated ref prefixes. An agent branch whose tip is in the history of a ref under one of them counts as kept, and /tidy may delete it.
